message_text: Dear customer, your SBI YONO account will be blocked today due to pending KYC update. Click here to update pan immediately: http://sbi-kyc-update.apk
red_flags: Sent from a random 10-digit mobile number, not official bank shortcode.
Asks you to download an .apk application file.
Creates false urgency by threatening account blockage today.
safe_action: Never download APK files sent via SMS. Contact your local SBI branch directly or use the official YONO app.

message_text: Bhaiya galti se aapke UPI par ₹2,000 transfer ho gaye hain. Please meri behen ki dawai ke liye refund kar do. Maine Google Pay par collect request bheji hai, bas accept kar lo.
red_flags: Fraudster sent a 'Collect Request' instead of asking for direct transfer.
Entering UPI PIN on a collect request debits your money instead of receiving or refunding.
Emotional manipulation using urgency and medical emergency.
safe_action: Check your actual bank balance in your official UPI app. If money was not credited, ignore. Never approve incoming collect requests.

message_text: Earn Rs 3000 to 8000 daily by simply liking YouTube videos and rating Google hotels! Work 30 mins from home. Contact HR Sneha on Telegram: @parttime_india_jobs
red_flags: Unrealistically high payout for trivial micro-tasks.
Directs communication to anonymous Telegram channels.
Will later demand a registration fee or prepaid deposit to release earnings.
safe_action: Block the sender immediately. Legitimate companies never recruit via unsolicited SMS offering thousands for liking videos.

message_text: Priye upbhokta, aapka bijli bill pending hai. Aaj raat 9:30 baje bijli disconnect kar di jayegi. Turant bijli adhikari Sharma ji se 9823412345 par sampark karein.
red_flags: Official electricity boards never send disconnection threats from personal cell numbers.
Threatens immediate same-night power cut without prior formal bill notices.
Instructs to call a personal number instead of official power discom portal.
safe_action: Check pending electricity dues only on your state discom's official portal or app (e.g., BESCOM, TNEB, Tata Power).

message_text: Congratulation! Your phone number has won 25,00,000 INR in KBC WhatsApp Lucky Draw 2025. Contact SBI manager Rana Pratap on WhatsApp +917004123456 to claim cheque.
red_flags: You cannot win a lottery you never entered.
WhatsApp lotteries are 100% fraudulent advance-fee schemes.
Asks you to contact an alleged bank official via personal WhatsApp.
safe_action: Delete the message and report on the Cybercrime portal (cybercrime.gov.in or 1930).

message_text: A/c *1204 Credited with INR 35,000.00 on 01-Nov-24 by NEFT salary transfer from TECH CORP PVT LTD. Avl Bal: INR 42,500.00. - HDFC Bank
red_flags: Legitimate alphanumeric header (AX-HDFCBK) registered with TRAI.
Does not contain suspicious external links or phone numbers.
Standard transactional credit notice masking account digits (*1204).
safe_action: No action needed. You can verify balance anytime on official HDFC netbanking or mobile app.

message_text: Sir, main PhonePe customer care se bol raha hoon. Aapke pending cashback ₹4,999 ko activate karne ke liye PlayStore se 'QuickSupport' app install karein aur 9-digit code share karein.
red_flags: Customer support will never ask you to install screen-sharing software (QuickSupport, AnyDesk).
Sharing the 9-digit remote access code gives fraudster complete view and control of your device.
Unsolicited call/message offering free cashback.
safe_action: Never install remote access tools recommended by callers. Disconnect and report the number on Chakshu portal.

message_text: Sir, I want to buy 5 sarees from your shop. I am sending payment via QR code. Please scan this QR code and enter your UPI PIN to receive ₹12,500 advance payment.
red_flags: Scanning a QR code and entering your UPI PIN is solely for PAYING money, never receiving.
Legitimate buyers pay directly to your shop's static QR soundbox.
Attempt to steal money under the pretext of advance wholesale order.
safe_action: Refuse to scan any QR code to receive payments. Advise the buyer to scan your merchant QR code.

message_text: Dear Airtel User, your SIM card will be deactivated within 12 hours due to pending document verification. Call our nodal officer at 08069123456 to prevent disconnection.
red_flags: Spoofed header or unverified regional routing.
Arbitrary 12-hour deadline to induce panic.
Directs call to an unofficial virtual phone number setup by cybercriminals.
safe_action: Visit an authorized Airtel retail gallery or check SIM status on the official Airtel Thanks app.

message_text: Paid Rs 320 to Fresh Groceries Store via UPI Ref 430129482910 on 05-Nov-24 18:22:10. Updated ICICI A/c Bal is Rs 18,400. - ICICI Bank
red_flags: Standard transactional format with valid 12-digit UPI reference number.
Verified TRAI registered header (VK-ICICIB).
No urgency, threats, or external redirection links.
safe_action: Routine transactional notification for groceries bought. No response required.

message_text: CBI & Cyber Crime Cell notice: An arrest warrant has been issued against your Aadhaar for illegal money laundering packages. Join immediate Skype investigation or face arrest.
red_flags: Concept of 'Digital Arrest' via Skype or video call does not exist under Indian law.
Law enforcement agencies never send summons or arrest notices via SMS or WhatsApp.
Extreme psychological intimidation to extort funds into 'safe police custody accounts'.
safe_action: Do not join video calls. Call the National Cybercrime Helpline 1930 immediately.

message_text: Exclusive Pre-IPO allocation! Invest ₹10,000 today in VIP SEBI-certified Telegram group and get guaranteed ₹50,000 return in 7 days. Register at http://invest-wealth-growth.vip
red_flags: Guaranteed returns of 400-500% in days are financially impossible and illegal.
Uses unverified .vip domain and private Telegram groups.
SEBI explicitly warns that registered entities never solicit via Telegram groups.
safe_action: Never transfer money to personal accounts for investment. Verify registered brokers only on sebi.gov.in.

message_text: Bill paid successfully! INR 850.00 debited from A/c XX4412 for BESCOM Electricity bill payment via Tata Neu. Transaction ID 9823019283.
red_flags: Official transactional receipt for a routine utility payment.
Legitimate masked account notation and standard reference ID.
No suspicious links or requests for credentials.
safe_action: Normal utility debit receipt. Keep for records.

message_text: Bhai ₹500 chai aur snacks ka share bhej diya hai Google Pay par. Check kar lena. - Rahul
red_flags: Casual peer-to-peer message from a known friend.
Does not ask to click links, download software, or enter PIN.
Informational note about a split expense.
safe_action: Verify in your Google Pay or banking transaction history.

message_text: Bank alert: Your Netbanking session expired. To prevent unauthorise access, visit http://192.168.1.104/hdfc-login and re-enter your customer ID and password.
red_flags: Links to an unencrypted raw IP address instead of hdfcbank.com.
Grammatical errors ('unauthorise access').
Directs to harvest login customer ID and netbanking password.
safe_action: Never enter banking credentials into links received via SMS. Always type the bank URL manually in your browser.

message_text: Income Tax Department: Refund of INR 24,580 approved for PAN Axxxxxx9K. Click here to confirm your bank account and receive direct credit within 24 hours: http://incometax-efiling-refund.vip
red_flags: Sent from personal mobile number instead of official ITD portal sender (e.g. VK-ITRDEPT).
Directs to an unverified third-party domain (.vip) to harvest bank account and OTP.
The Income Tax Department never sends direct links to claim refunds; refunds credit automatically to pre-validated bank accounts.
safe_action: Check your refund status solely by logging into the official portal (eportal.incometax.gov.in). Never click SMS links.

message_text: EPFO Notice: Dear member, your UAN 100928391029 has been locked due to unlinked Aadhaar. Download KYC update tool to restore pension benefits: http://epfindia-service.apk
red_flags: Urgent claim that UAN and pension are frozen.
Distributes an untrusted .apk application file.
EPFO updates happen exclusively through the unified member portal (unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in).
safe_action: Never install APK files sent via SMS. Manage your provident fund strictly on epfindia.gov.in or the UMANG app.

message_text: A/c *4092 Credited: INR 12,450.00 on 12-Nov-24 by corporate travel expense reimbursement from TECH SOLUTIONS PVT LTD. Ref: CORP918239. - AXIS Bank
red_flags: Official TRAI registered bank header (AX-AXISBK).
Valid corporate reference identifier matching standard accounting payouts.
No suspicious links or urgent calls to action.
safe_action: Routine corporate travel reimbursement. No action required.
